theme_and_archetype.description: Professional, minimalist, and clear invoice layout resembling Blinkit's tax invoice format. Stark white background with high-contrast text to ensure excellent readability and perfect rendering for html2canvas/PDF downloads.

typography.alignment: Left-aligned for textual data, Right-aligned for numerical data (amounts, quantities, prices).

layout_and_spacing.container: max-w-2xl mx-auto p-6 md:p-10 bg-white border border-zinc-200 shadow-sm rounded-xl
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous padding: p-6 or p-8 inside the main container. gap-6 between grid sections.

sections.header: flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center pb-6 border-b border-zinc-100 gap-4
sections.footer: mt-12 pt-6 border-t border-zinc-100 flex flex-col items-center gap-4

components_instructions.general: Build the Order Summary primarily with pure HTML tags and Tailwind CSS (div, header, table, tr, th, td). Avoid complex Shadcn interactive components INSIDE the printable container to ensure perfect compatibility with html2canvas. Keep the printable container clean and static.
components_instructions.document_title: Must explicitly say 'Order Summary' in the header.
components_instructions.table: Use clean, border-bottom only rows. `th` should be text-xs, uppercase, tracking-wider, text-zinc-500, py-3. `td` should be py-4 border-b border-zinc-100. Maintain right alignment for 'Amount', 'Qty', 'Price'.

orange_pharmacy.disclaimer: This is a provisional order summary. Final invoice will be sent with your order delivery.

mango_health_labs.disclaimer: This is a provisional order summary. Final invoice will be sent after sample collection.

components_instructions.download_button: Include a 'Download as PDF/Image' button OUTSIDE the printable area. Use Shadcn Button for this, styled with a download icon (lucide-react).

orange_pharmacy_logo.description: Logo for Orange Pharmacy. Place in the top-left of the header when rendering Orange Pharmacy summary.

mango_health_labs_logo.description: Logo for Mango Health Labs. Place in the top-left of the header when rendering Mango Health Labs summary.

nevika_cura_logo.description: Logo for Nevika Cura. Place in the small footer at the very bottom center, alongside 'Powered by Nevika Cura'.

testing_attributes.requirements: Add data-testid to all key elements (e.g., data-testid='order-summary-container', data-testid='download-button', data-testid='platform-logo', data-testid='total-amount', data-testid='disclaimer-text').
